About

Hold to charge a giant slingshot, release to fling Spud across a bright 3D field. Smash crate towers for potato coins, bounce off mushrooms, and climb an unlock ladder: Double Band, Bouncy Mushrooms, Air Toot, Pond of Gulpo, Mega Band, and Golden Spud. After the Gulpo unlock, a giant frog at the pond can swallow Spud and spit the potato out for a burst of distance. Single-player, one continuous progression mode. Progress saves locally in your browser.

How to play / controls

Hold Space, Enter, mouse, or touch to charge; release to launch. During flight, press again for the unlocked Air Toot. After landing, press to reset.
